degree_requirement.value: Bachelor’s degree in Informatics / Computer Science equivalent to the B.Sc. Informatics taught at TUM
degree_requirement.quote: Students with a Bachelor’s degree in Informatics / Computer Science which is equivalent to the B.Sc. Informatics taught at TUM are eligible to apply.

value.min_scores: minimal qualifying score of the respective year

entrance_tests.quote: Applicants with a Degree from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran or Pakistan have to submit a GRE (General) Test.

work_experience.quote: Certificates from professional training or additional qualifications related to the program (e.g. participation in research competitions, internships, etc.) (not mandatory)

aps_required.quote: Applicants with an undergraduate degree from China, India and Vietnam have to submit a certificate from the German Evaluation Center (APS).

application_route.quote: Applicants who did not obtain their qualification for postgraduate studies (usually a bachelor's degree) in Germany must apply for a preliminary documentation (VPD) from uni-assist, additionally to the TUM application.

deadlines.quote: Application period for the winter semester: 01.02. – 31.05. Application period for the summer semester: 01.10. – 30.11.

selection_process.value: Two-stage aptitude assessment process evaluating academic qualifications/grades, written documents (essay, motivation statement), and a written test/interview.
selection_process.quote: The aptitude assessment for the M.Sc. Informatics is a two-stage process in which we assess your qualification with regard to the special qualitative requirements of this Master's program.

value: Bachelor's degree certificate or official transcript of records
Curriculum (module descriptions, course catalog or syllabus)
GRE or GATE score for applicants from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Pakistan
Preliminary documentation from uni-assist (VPD) for degrees outside Germany
APS certificate for degrees from China, Vietnam, or India

tuition_eur_per_semester_non_eu.quote: The tuition fees for international students from third countries for this degree program are 6,000 euros per semester .

language_of_instruction.quote: The language of instruction for this program is usually English.
